headline: Argentina Seeks to Tax Foreign Equity CEDEAR Investments
summary: The Argentine government sent a financial competitiveness bill to Congress proposing to eliminate the current tax exemption on CEDEARs, applying income tax to operations starting October 31, 2026.
why: CEDEARs are extremely popular local certificates representing foreign stocks traded on Wall Street, and changing their tax treatment directly alters retail and institutional investment returns in Argentina.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Removing tax exemptions on popular investment instruments affects local capital market dynamics.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Taxing popular instruments like CEDEARs alters investor sentiment and domestic capital allocation away from foreign equity proxies.
